original.target_description: Study 1: repeated-measures ANOVA main effect of basis of variety, colored dots versus unfilled geometric shapes, on percentage-filled estimates.

n.quote:
Eighty participants estimated the quantity of items in 50
random patterns of colored dots or common shapes
n.sample_role: Participants contributing repeated quantity estimates across 50 within-participant stimulus conditions; target ANOVA uses these 80 participants.
n.exclusions: No participant exclusions reported for Study 1; target test degrees of freedom are consistent with all 80 participants.

es.location: p. 409 (PDF p. 4), Study 1 Results, repeated-measures ANOVA

p.location: p. 409 (PDF p. 4), Study 1 Results, repeated-measures ANOVA

replication.target_description: Study 5 kind-of-object main effect (colored dots versus shapes) requested. The final article names this factor in its 5 × 5 × 2 ANOVA but does not print a statistic, effect size, p value, or analytic n for this term in Study 5 Results (p. 9).

reported_success.quote: we again failed to replicate the effect of variety on perceived quantity.

notes:
Full replication paper available and title verified. Supplied p. 22 differs from final publication. Target test not reported in located Results; other ANOVA terms were not substituted. Failure verdict is authors’ study-level verdict for variety, not a verdict for kind of object.
Source follow-up: Published article; supplied title and DOI match. Source text encodes equals as p and less-than as ! in statistical expressions. Requested printed F test retained without effect-size conversion. Replication and reported_success are unassigned.
